description: Defines the 'Parser' class for parsing DER-encoded ASN.1 structures, including methods for reading tags, values, sequences, and primitive types, with focus on DER TLV structure parsing.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class for parsing DER-encoded ASN.1 structures, supporting reading tags, values, sequences, and primitive types, with methods for navigating TLV data.

methods.name: Parser
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty parser.

methods.name: Parser(const Input& input)
methods.description: Constructs a parser over the provided input data.

methods.name: HasMore
methods.description: Checks if there is more data to parse.

methods.name: ReadTagAndValue
methods.description: Reads current TLV, outputs tag and value, advances parser.

methods.name: ReadRawTLV
methods.description: Reads current TLV as raw bytes, advances parser.

methods.name: ReadOptionalTag
methods.description: Reads optional tag, outputs value if present.

methods.name: ReadOptionalTag (deprecated)
methods.description: Reads optional tag, outputs value and presence flag.

methods.name: ReadTag
methods.description: Reads specific tag, outputs value if matches.

methods.name: ReadConstructed
methods.description: Reads constructed type with specific tag, outputs new parser.

methods.name: ReadSequence
methods.description: Reads a sequence (tag 0x30), outputs new parser.

methods.name: ReadBitString
methods.description: Reads a BIT STRING, returns BitString or nullopt.

methods.name: PeekTagAndValue
methods.description: Peeks at current tag and value without advancing.
